subject: FINDING: Fold7 transition has three distinct layers — physical power, logical route, renderability
body: CONFIRMED_BY_CURRENT_MAIN+AOSP: DuoShellService already treats Fold7 physical panel IDs as stable-ish role identity and logical IDs as disposable routes. Physical wake uses SurfaceControl.getPhysicalDisplayToken(id)+setDisplayPowerMode(NORMAL) before a logical route necessarily exists. Cover prewarm then waits for a non-default 1080x2520 logical route, enables it, re-resolves because Samsung may remap synchronously, verifies it still maps to the owned physical cover, and requests logical STATE_ON. Fold7CoverReadiness adds a third gate requiring app-visible topology. AOSP LogicalDisplayMapper explicitly remaps/swapDisplaysLocked underlying DisplayDevices among LogicalDisplays on foldables and notifies WindowManager on display switch. Therefore the transition must be modeled as at least (1) physical panel power/token, (2) logical display route/default role, (3) renderability/composition. Logical display ID is not physical identity. Current coordinator isActive(state != OFF/UNKNOWN) over-admits suspended/doze states; Android documents ON_SUSPEND and DOZE_SUSPEND as CPU-not-updating. Cross-agent consequence: Agent02 wallpaper anchors must track current display/token identity rather than one default logical display; Agent04 latency should timestamp all three boundaries; Agent05 must not infer compositor readiness from panel power or route existence; Agent07 should look for Samsung signals around LogicalDisplayMapper/device-state remap. No production changes made.
